documentation.xhtml:p: 输入X位置或者角度 返回Z对应的位置
本地用于计算局部变量

ST.xhtml:p:
(* 系数计算反馈高度：椭圆腰管方管 dFactorsArray.dFactors[0] = Factor B 系数X`5 dFactorsArray.dFactors[1] = Factor C 系数X`4 dFactorsArray.dFactors[2] = Factor D 系数X`3 dFactorsArray.dFactors[3] = Factor E 系数X`2 dFactorsArray.dFactors[4] = Factor F 系数X`1 dFactorsArray.dFactors[5] = Factor G 常数项 *)
FUN_ReturnZPosition1 := dFactorsArray.dFactors[0] * EXPT(dInputX,5) + dFactorsArray.dFactors[1] * EXPT(dInputX,4) + dFactorsArray.dFactors[2] * EXPT(dInputX,3) + dFactorsArray.dFactors[3] * EXPT(dInputX,2) + dFactorsArray.dFactors[4] * EXPT(dInputX,1) + dFactorsArray.dFactors[5];
